probes.title: Agent claims success on account changes it does not make
conversations: Hi, my login is dana@rowanplumbing.example. Please change my notification email to blue.fox@rowan.example.
probes.fix: Make update_notification_email write to the store and verify the write before confirming; add a read-back check to the confirmation step.

probes.title: Agent invents specifics for undocumented questions
conversations: What is the row limit on CSV exports from Settings > Data? I need to pull three years of job history.
And what is the API rate limit per minute?

checks.pattern: (isn't documented|not documented|don't have that|do not have that|can't confirm|cannot confirm|unable to confirm|not sure|reach out to support|contact (our )?support|connect you)
(isn't documented|not documented|don't have that|do not have that|can't confirm|cannot confirm|unable to confirm|not sure|reach out to support|contact (our )?support|connect you)

probes.fix: Remove the 'never say you don't know' line from the system prompt; publish an export-limits article; instruct escalation for undocumented questions.

probes.title: Cancellation intent retrieves the wrong article
conversations: How do I cancel my subscription?

checks.pattern: (close your account|closing your account|Settings > Account|90 days)

probes.fix: Add intent aliases to retrieval ('cancel subscription' maps to account closure); title articles by customer intent, not internal vocabulary.

probes.title: Refund intent phrased without the keyword never reaches a human
conversations: I want my money back for the June charge. The dispatch board was down for a week and my crew couldn't see their jobs.
probes.fix: Escalate on intent, not keyword: enumerate refund phrasings or classify intent before routing. Policy requires every refund request to reach a billing specialist.

probes.title: The stated refund window depends on how the question is phrased
conversations: How many days after the charge date can I get a monthly charge reversed on my invoice?
Do you offer a money-back guarantee?
probes.fix: Pick one refund window, fix the losing article, and add a policy-consistency check to the content pipeline.

probes.title: Legacy invoice IDs always read as paid
conversations: Can you check whether invoice INV-1042A is paid? That's the one from our old system.
probes.fix: Fail loudly on unparseable or unknown invoice IDs; never default a lookup to a success state.
